note: The fill revision introduced rejection of all context flags. Read-only stepping observed CreateContext returning STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED during adapter initialization with valid node, affinity and private size; its nested flags value was not expanded. Initialize returned STATUS_NO_MEMORY despite about 2 GiB available. The documented system paging context must be accepted. Revision 5db40e5 admits only that flag and keeps user rendering excluded from system contexts; live retry is separate evidence. The fill probe was not launched against the failed adapter. An initial cleanup-task launch exited 0xc0000005 before updating its report; retry finalized successfully and preserved the original display.
